'''Zarus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[General/Legends|Field General]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="STF" />

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Zarus was a part of the Imperial military forces guarding the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. He was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during a joint [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Balmorran resistance]] operation to weaken Imperial presence in the area.<ref name="STF" />
